WAFFLE.gloss: pancake batter baked in a waffle iron
WAFFLE.definition: Pancake batter baked in a waffle iron.

LEAF.gloss: the main organ of photosynthesis and transpiration in higher plants
LEAF.definition: The main organ of photosynthesis and transpiration in higher plants.

FLAW.gloss: an imperfection in an object or machine
FLAW.definition: An imperfection in an object or machine.
FLAW.example: A flaw caused the crystal to shatter.

FLEA.gloss: any wingless bloodsucking parasitic insect noted for ability to leap
FLEA.definition: Any wingless bloodsucking parasitic insect noted for ability to leap.

FEW.gloss: a quantifier that can be used with count nouns and is often preceded by `a'
FEW.definition: A quantifier that can be used with count nouns and is often preceded by `a'; a small but indefinite number.

LAW.gloss: the collection of rules imposed by authority
LAW.definition: The collection of rules imposed by authority.
LAW.example: Civilization presupposes respect for the law.

AWE.gloss: an overwhelming feeling of wonder or admiration
AWE.definition: An overwhelming feeling of wonder or admiration.
AWE.example: He stared over the edge with a feeling of awe.

ALE.gloss: a general name for beer made with a top fermenting yeast
ALE.definition: A general name for beer made with a top fermenting yeast; in some of the United States an ale is (by law) a brew of more than 4% alcohol by volume.
